diagnosis.provider_pattern: The Moonshot route repeatedly returned finish_reason=error near 785 seconds during a single long S4 response. Two attempts completed Raw S4 but failed Proofpress S4 at the same boundary; the remaining attempts failed Raw S4.
diagnosis.not_a_cap_hit: Successful Raw responses used 20,236-24,138 output tokens under the unchanged aggregate 64,000-token S4 guardrail. Failed responses reported provider error rather than finish_reason=length or an exact cap hit.
diagnosis.interrupted_attempt: Explicit attempt 12 was stopped and preserved before S4 output so this correction could be frozen before any repaired quality result.

segments: Opening, metadata, executive summary, material facts, and transaction or agreement overview
Issue-by-issue, deviation, evidence, conflict, authority, and risk analysis
Recommendations, mitigants, conditions, escalation or approval requests, decision blocks, appendices, and remaining required content
correction.receipt_rule: Every planned segment is a distinct pinned-provider call with its own request ID and eligibility check. Any failed, truncated, mismatched, or cap-hitting segment invalidates the entire paired attempt.
correction.resume_rule: Within one explicit attempt, an already completed eligible segment may be read from its immutable receipt after a local process interruption. Provider failures are never resumed or converted; the entire attempt remains invalid.
correction.panel_rule: Generate a new 18-cell Kimi panel under this single protocol. The three earlier monolithic valid cells remain route calibration and are excluded from the v11 replication estimate.

claim_boundary: The segmentation is an adapter-compatibility correction, not a quality optimization selected from repaired outcomes. Kimi v11 results may be compared within their paired cells but must not silently pool prior monolithic cells into the v11 estimate.
